name: EONO3D
summary: Amazon brand with a broad range: PETG (1 kg and 6-10 kg bundles at about $10-16/kg), PLA (matte, silk tri-colour, glitter galaxy, marble, conductive), TPU (standard, matte, silk, flexible), PHA, PP, PP glass-fibre and carbon-fibre, and PVA. The seller is a Guangzhou industrial company; the extruder is unknown.

product_lines.name: PETG
product_lines.notes: 1 kg $9.99-15.58; 6 kg and 10 kg bundles $9.83-10.80/kg, including translucent.

product_lines.name: PLA Conductive
product_lines.notes: 1 kg black, $34.99, sold as electrically conductive for ESD and sensors. No conductive-PLA filament id exists, so no filament_ids.

product_lines.name: TPU (standard, matte, silk, flexible)
product_lines.notes: 1 kg $16.99-28.99; 4 x 250 g packs; hardness not given in titles.
